title: 1993 VTG McDonaldland Racing Team Ronald Rocket Racing Champion 1:64 McDonald’s
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Diecast & Toy Vehicles:Cars: Racing, NASCAR:Sport & Touring Cars
descriptionText: The product is a 1994 Racing Champions diecast car featuring the McDonaldland Racing Team Ronald Rocket Racing Champion in 1:64 scale. This collectible item represents the iconic McDonald's character, Ronald McDonald, as a NASCAR driver. The car is designed in red color, staying true to the brand's signature look, making it a valuable addition for collectors of vintage racing memorabilia and fans of the McDonald's franchise.
